name: Communion Of The Lord S Supper
overview: The Communion of the Lord's Supper is deeply rooted in the Old Testament Passover ordinance, where God instructed Israel to observe the blood of the lamb on their doorposts as a sign of protection and deliverance (Exodus 12:21-23). This service was to be kept as a lasting ordinance, to be explained to future generations as a memorial of God's saving grace (Exodus 12:24-26). These verses establish the foundation for the New Testament practice of communion, emphasizing the significance of Christ's body and blood in the believer's spiritual life and the necessity of solemn remembrance and reverence in partaking.
